title: CONFLICT SCENARIOS IN THIS BOOK
use_cases: Use when drafting plot outlines to identify high-stakes obstacles for characters
Configure when character arcs require specific catalysts for personal growth or development
Implement when brainstorming minor to disastrous consequences for character actions
Use when developing internal character struggles or secondary plot points
Use when structuring 'No-Win' scenarios to force impossible choices on a protagonist
content:
From moral dilemmas to ticking clocks, you’ll discover endless ways to complicate your characters’ lives. Each of the following conflict scenarios provides a list of possible consequences (minor to disastrous), inner struggles, and ways it can be used to trigger personal development and growth.
